alternatives.option: Keep injecting the gate prose alongside the working set on v3
alternatives.reason_rejected: fails the oracle and reintroduces instruction-only reliance the programme exists to remove

context: Lane 03 (runtime) delivered on lane/03-runtime: v3 adapters (identity, ceremony, working set, receipts, Claude Code + Codex + library adapters, git connector), CLI v3 verbs, hooks incl. PreCompact and compact SessionStart; Claude real-host evidence captured; Codex not tested (hook trust); gaps 1/2/4 flipped.
rationale: R10 requires capture and bounded injection without a prose instruction, and oracle C15 A2-NO-PROSE forbids the literal gate strings in any payload delivered to a model. This is the package's central outcome, so the lane's implementation stands; it is flagged for Dave because it changes what every v3 session sees at start. 2.x behavior is untouched so field users are unaffected until they migrate.
summary: On a v3 store the SessionStart hook injects ONLY the bounded working set (no 'Gate 1'/'Gate 2' instruction prose), while 2.x stores keep today's gate text; the gates on v3 are enforced by the hooks themselves (capture, commit gate, stop gate), not by prose the model must remember
